title: Layout-Aware OCR in Black Digital Archives: An Unsupervised Evaluation Approach
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical and linguistic metrics (mAP, Semantic Coherence Score, Region Entropy) for evaluating document layout analysis and OCR.
